mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1200 (thousands of units) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns as the market anticipates sustained growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in >40% of instances when HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 235 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains above 0.1%, the market anticipates monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns as investors price in reduced liquidity and growth concerns.
regime_hint: high inflation and restrictive monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in >50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 235 AND FEDFUNDS > 0.1, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, the market perceives economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings potential, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as investors anticipate policy responses and lower growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO > 100) signals robust supply chain conditions and strong economic output, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns as the market prices in sustained growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in >40% of instances when INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 445,000 (millions of dollars), it indicates strong consumer spending and economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as the market anticipates continued growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >50% of instances when RSAFS > 445000, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5% and employment (PAYEMS) falls below 142,000 (thousands of persons), it signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns as investors react to weakening economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in >40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5 AND PAYEMS < 142000, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 236, the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns as investors price in reduced liquidity and higher risk.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in >50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 236, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
